what: Final latency bench of the shipped decoder core (build 6g, src/core/) on machine A of tuning/KNOWLEDGE.md section 0.2, at the overclocked and at the stock GPU profile: single-handle back-to-back rows (cap curve at alpha 0.5 and the presets), paired rows against the earlier builds 6e and 6f and against a second copy of itself (A/A), and cadence / keep-warm rows. Pre-registered plan; summary statistics as recorded (us, nearest-rank quantiles, 3 decimals).

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (Blackwell, sm_120, 84 SMs, 64 MiB L2)
machine.host_setup: bench mode: CPUs 3-7,11-15 isolated (isolcpus, nohz_full, rcu_nocbs), housekeeping on 0-2,8-10; every timed process alone on one isolated CPU; governor performance, EPP performance, boost on

build: 6g = the frozen core of src/core/ (fastbpgpu6g), AVX-512 host core, Release, CUDA 13.3.73, built for the measurement harness; 6e and 6f are earlier builds of the same decoder line (tuning/KNOWLEDGE.md section 0.5)

method.single_handle: part P (cap curve, alpha 0.5) and part S (presets): one handle per process, back to back, 20,000 shots per process; P 3 processes per row, S 4; pooled quantiles; OSD-path and converged classes split by the status word
method.paired: parts A and B: candidate and reference handles in one process on the same shots, fixed pseudo-random interleave, create order alternating between processes, 20,000 shots per side per process; delta = candidate - reference of the pooled quantiles; the A/A band is the largest |delta| of the 6g-copy vs 6g rows of that preset (section 7.1 of tuning/KNOWLEDGE.md)
method.cadence: parts D and G: bb144 xyz a03125c3, one handle, 6 repetitions of 2,000 calls; a busy-wait host gap before each call; keep_warm() every 0.5 ms through the gap or not
method.shots: fresh shot sets of the problem, the same set for both sides of a pair; outputs compared shot by shot on every paired run

cadence.keep_warm: every 0.5 ms through the gap, the last call 1 us before the decode
every 0.5 ms through the gap, the last call 25 us before the decode
every 0.5 ms through the gap, the last call 1 us before the decode
every 0.5 ms through the gap, the last call 25 us before the decode
